description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the composition of the Darija Open Dataset (Version 2) across six labeled categories, with a legend on the right mapping colors to labels and numeric value labels shown inside several slices. There are 6 slices: “Translated Sentences” (yellow) is the largest slice and is labeled 45,387 (roughly about one-third of the ring), “Pending Translations” (light green) is labeled 43,000 (also roughly about one-third), “Extra + Augmented Data” (blue) is labeled 30,000 (about one-fifth to one-quarter), and “Moroccan Names” (orange) is labeled 23,108 (around one-sixth). Two very thin slices near the top correspond to “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” (purple) and “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” (brown/orange), each appearing as a narrow sliver with no readable numeric label. No slice is exploded or offset, and the segments appear arranged around the ring without an explicit descending-size order.
